title: Seller Settings
brief:
As a shop owner, I want each seller to be able to customize its own features and limits, so that sellers can differ from the shop defaults where they need to.

Acceptance criteria:
- A seller that sets no value of its own gets the shop default for it.
- A seller's own value replaces the default, for each feature and each limit separately.
- An operation that would take a seller over one of its limits is rejected (429) and does not run.
- An operation that adds several items at once is rejected unless all of them fit.

steps.summary: Add the seller feature and limit types plus the shop defaults
Merge the shop defaults with each seller's overrides
Add the 429 limit error and the usage checks that wrap an operation
Add tests for config merging and limit checks, document the model

probes.question: What is the shop default for maxUsers?
A seller overrides only { features: { refunds: false } }. Is analytics enabled for it?
A seller with maxUsers 5 has no users yet. withinLimit is called to invite 6 users at once (amount 6). What happens?

items.question: A seller overrides its limits with { maxUsers: null }. What is its effective maxUsers limit?
A seller's overrides contain a limit the shop does not have: { limits: { maxWidgets: 3 } }. What happens to it?
options: It is dropped from the effective limits
It is kept in the effective limits
Resolving the configuration rejects it as invalid

items.question: A seller has overridden maxProducts with null and already has 100 products; the shop default is 100. It adds 1 product through withinLimit. What happens?
options: It runs: null means the seller has no limit

items.question: A seller with a maxProducts limit of 100 has 98 products and imports 5 at once through withinLimit. What happens?
options: The import runs and all 5 are added
Only 2 of the 5 products are imported
The import is rejected as invalid (400)

items.question: A seller overrides its limits with { maxUsers: 0 } and has no users yet. It adds one user through withinLimit. What happens?
options: It runs: 0 counts as not set, so the default of 5 applies
